text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on the west side of Dwight Avenue, from a point 63 metres north of Birmingham Street to a point 100 metres south of New Toronto Street. This regulation will prohibit vehicles from parking in the area and will deter the excessive long term parking that is taking place within this area.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing "Permitted Angle Parking" on the west side of Dwight Avenue between Birmingham Street and New Toronto Street. 2. Prohibited parking at all times, on the west side of Dwight Avenue, between a point 63 metres north of Birmingham Street and a point 100 metres south of New Toronto Street.
